text: OpenAICompatRunner.run returns a ChatReply whose cost_usd is 0.0 for every model and endpoint.
quote: always returns a `ChatReply` with `cost_usd` of 0.0, whatever the model or endpoint

text: OpenAICompatRunner must not compute a price from a model name or from a built-in price table.
quote: It never computes a price from a model name or a built-in table.

text: runner_for builds an OpenAICompatRunner for both the openai: prefix and the ollama: prefix.
quote: `runner_for` in `src/adrcheck/adapters/providers.py` builds `OpenAICompatRunner` for both the `openai:` and the `ollama:` prefix, so both report zero cost.

text: No price table is added to src/adrcheck/adapters/openai_compat.py or src/adrcheck/adapters/providers.py.
quote: No price table is added to either file.

text: OpenAICompatRunner reports tokens_in and tokens_out in its reply.
docs/providers.md states that a cost_usd of 0 for the openai: and ollama: providers means the cost is not reported, not that the call is free.
A non-zero cost must not be reported for the openai: or ollama: runners unless a new ADR supersedes ADR-14.
quote: Reporting a real figure from these runners would change what the field means for users who rely on it, so it needs a new record that supersedes this one.
